01 /

Fund your next move

Choose a payment method currently enabled in your wallet. Card payments use Stripe Checkout when available. Manual methods display the payment image, name and instructions set by the administrator. Submit your payment reference after following those instructions.

02 /

Understand your balances

Your available balance is the amount you can use for a new stake or allocation. Funds committed to stakes, copy positions or pending withdrawals are tracked separately. A payment reference or a successful redirect alone does not add funds.

03 /

Credit codes, made simple

If you receive a promotional code, enter its 16 letters and numbers in your wallet. A valid, unused code credits its assigned amount once. Credited funds can be staked or withdrawn, subject to approved KYC, the withdrawal minimum and payout review.

04 /

Withdraw with a clear trail

Complete verification, choose an available withdrawal method, enter the required recipient details and review the amount. Funds are reserved while the administrator reviews your request. A rejected request returns the reserved funds.
